phase.description: Which phase to run: draft = produce the content draft for user confirmation; arrange = turn the user-confirmed draft into the final page plan.

instruction.description: User instruction for this slides task; always the highest priority.

roomId.description: Target room id injected by the gateway; binds the read tools to the room. Required.

roomTitle.description: Optional room title for context framing.

prewarmToken.description: arrange only: image-prewarm token injected by the gateway when image generation is available. Copy it verbatim into slides_image_prewarm for pages with an imagePrompt.

title.description: Deck title requested by the user; derive one when absent.

outline.description: draft only: per-page titles requested by the user (order = page order; first item is the cover). Treat as the skeleton when present.

draftPages.description: arrange only: pages parsed back from the user-confirmed draft document (their edits are authoritative).

referenceStyle.description: reference-style/v1 extracted from a reference deck; palette/density/darkCover/composition/pageBudget.

referenceOutline.description: Reference deck section titles; cover the main sections without dropping them.

targetPages.description: Desired page count; overrides reference pageBudget.

deckStyle.description: Minimal design brief from the confirmed style card (composition / darkCover / motif / palette). Use it for material choice and imagePrompt light-dark base; do not write hex colors into copy.
